images.prompt:
Original cosy autumn colouring-book line art in clean black ink on white paper; bold rounded outer contours, smooth subtly hand-drawn linework, medium-weight interior details, broad colourable enclosed shapes, friendly softly stylised cartoon expressions, sparse natural and handmade texture marks, no filled shading, calm storybook warmth and home-printer-friendly clarity.

SHARED STYLE (style only): illustration style: Cosy seasonal colouring-book line art with original storybook charm, using playful rounded forms and inviting domestic-scale detail.; line weight: Bold black outer contours with medium-weight interior detail lines; maintain generous enclosed colouring areas.; line quality: Smooth, gently imperfect hand-inked curves with softened corners and clear, steady joins.; detail level: Medium detail: clear focal silhouettes supported by selectively simplified decorative texture; avoid tiny marks and overly intricate repeats.; character language: Friendly, softly stylised cartoon characters with rounded proportions, simple expressive faces, and readable clothing or feature shapes.; background density: Moderately full scenic backgrounds built in shallow layers, with enough open space inside forms for relaxed colouring.; palette: Monochrome black ink on white paper; designs should suggest a warm autumn atmosphere through motif and linework rather than filled colour.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No solid shading or grey fills; use sparse contour accents, simple texture lines, and occasional small pattern details only.; texture: Light hand-drawn texture through wood grain, leaf veins, fabric seams, masonry marks, and natural surface accents, always kept broad and colourable.; mood: Warm, peaceful, whimsical and gently festive, with an unhurried cosy feel.; print considerations: A4 and US Letter friendly portrait pages with clean white backgrounds, no full-bleed ink areas, strong line contrast, and details large enough to reproduce clearly on typical home printers..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Rich, cosy, slightly muted seasonal palette: pumpkin orange, burnt sienna, golden yellow, ochre, warm cream, walnut brown, moss/olive green, forest green, teal, slate blue, charcoal, and small luminous yellow highlights. The night design adds cool navy and blue-green contrast.; linework: Bold, near-black to dark-brown contour outlines, approximately 3–6 px at this display size. Outer silhouettes are heaviest; interior construction lines, seams, leaf veins, brick divisions, and wood grain are moderately thinner but remain clear. No delicate hatching.; texture: Subtle paper/grain or speckled overlay across fills, plus lightly irregular colour variation. Select objects include explicit decorative texture lines such as wood grain, brick joints, fabric ribs, roof scales, and leaf veins.; composition density: High but organised density. A large central focal subject anchors each cover, medium-sized supporting objects build a cosy environment, and small seasonal accents occupy gaps and borders. Foreground elements overlap the scene to create fullness without losing major silhouettes.; background: Fully illustrated scenic backgrounds, from dark moonlit woodland to café frontage and a garden patio. Backgrounds are layered with trees, shrubs, structures, props, and decorative seasonal elements; there is no plain or flat empty backdrop.; mood: Comforting, warm, whimsical, peaceful, and gently festive; the spooky elements are cute rather than frightening..
